instruction.name: xvfnmadd.d
instruction.description: Compute packed double precision floating point FMA(Fused Multiply-Add): multiply elements in `a` and `b`, accumulate to elements in `c` and store the negated result in `dst`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r4
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r4' --asm 'xvfnmadd.d $xr0, $xr0, $xr2, $xr3'

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfnmadd.d $xr0, $xr8, $xr16, $xr24; xvfnmadd.d $xr1, $xr9, $xr17, $xr25; xvfnmadd.d $xr2, $xr10, $xr18, $xr26; xvfnmadd.d $xr3, $xr11, $xr19, $xr27; xvfnmadd.d $xr4, $xr12, $xr20, $xr28; xvfnmadd.d $xr5, $xr13, $xr21, $xr29; xvfnmadd.d $xr6, $xr14, $xr22, $xr30; xvfnmadd.d $xr7, $xr15, $xr23, $xr31

notes: LBT-free LASX/LSX fused multiply-add. vd is write-only: it is not read as an accumulator (a vd -> vd chain runs at about 0.5 cycles). The vj, vk, and va paths each cost 5 cycles. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
